name: Fangirl
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve adult woman with radiating locs, round glasses, cream patterned off-shoulder tee, olive cargos, red sneakers, marker and signature board. Review board/fan continuity, glasses, fingers, original abstract autograph and cyan margins.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Fangirl — Day One.
IDENTITY: the exact dark-skinned adult woman with short outward-radiating black locs, large round black glasses, hoop/drop earrings, loose cream off-shoulder T-shirt with blue-and-ochre abstract shapes, dark olive cargo joggers, red/white/black high-top sneakers and black cross-body bag. Preserve her thick black marker and white autograph board. The autograph is an abstract looping black signature mark, not a new readable name. Keep reference costume intact.
0–0.7s: whole-character excited anticipation. She spots her imaginary idol beyond camera, hugs the autograph board close, then snaps it outward with a triumphant grin and sweeps the marker across its existing signature.
0.7–2.5s: the board UNFOLDS into a gigantic accordion paper fan, thirty feet wide in forced perspective, white panels with sweeping black signature strokes and bold warm rose-gold edges. Camera rockets backward to reveal the ridiculous scale and her tiny whole body firmly gripping its base. She delivers one full-body overhead fan swing that unleashes a colossal curling gust, carrying finite rose-and-gold heart-shaped paper cutouts in a powerful spiral. The gust surges past the camera with a huge ink-outlined impact star; its recoil lifts her into an exuberant midair kick. Keep the fan's complete outer contour and cyan margins visible; the fan is a physical foreground prop, never a wall or background panel.
2.5–3.5s: camera snap-zooms toward her delighted face as the giant fan folds rapidly back into the original autograph board. Exact title DAY ONE slams below her face in two large stable comic lines.
3.5–5s: settle into a full-body pose, autograph held proudly forward. A single heart-shaped paper cutout sticks to one glasses lens; she blows it away without losing her excited smile, then taps the autograph protectively with her marker. No new people or other words. SFX: marker squeak, thunderous paper unfolding, immense fanning WHUMP, rushing air and paper flutter, crisp folding snap and a tiny final lens tap. No speech, cheering or music.
